settings.desc: Hides the on-screen tab/player list while this module is enabled.

settings.name: Hide scoreboard sidebar
settings.desc: Hides the right-side scoreboard locally while this module is enabled.

modules.name: Chunk Borders

settings.name: Chunks around
settings.desc: 0 shows only the chunk you are in.

settings.name: Height
settings.desc: How far up and down the lines go.

settings.name: Section lines

modules.name: Block Outline

settings.name: Line width

settings.name: Colour shift

settings.name: Your skin

settings.name: Everyone else's skin

modules.name: Atmosphere
modules.description: A night sky with stars and a slow aurora on your screen. Only you see it.

settings.name: Time of day
settings.desc: The time you see. Leave: your own clock. The others hold the clock still so the sky stays the same.

settings.name: Theme
settings.desc: The colours of the aurora and the glow near the horizon.

settings.name: Stars
settings.desc: How many stars are drawn.

settings.name: Aurora
settings.desc: Soft curtains of light over the horizon.

settings.name: Brightness
settings.desc: How strong the stars and the aurora are.

settings.name: Clear weather

settings.name: Also in daylight
settings.desc: Draw the stars and the aurora even when the sun is up.

modules.name: Suspicious Chunks
modules.description: Finds chunks that look built by someone: bases, farms, hidden rooms. Names natural structures.

settings.name: Scan loaded multiplayer chunks
settings.desc: Allow scanning only chunk data your client has already received and loaded. No hidden or unloaded chunks are queried; this can use extra CPU on busy servers.

settings.name: How sure to be
settings.desc: How much has to be in a chunk before it is flagged. Medium finds a small hut with a bed, a chest and a furnace. High finds even a bed and a chest. Very high flags anything a player could have placed.

settings.name: Scan pace
settings.desc: Fast uses less frame time; Thorough spends more time processing the queue each tick. This changes scan throughput, not the scoring rules.

settings.name: Scan distance
settings.desc: How many chunks around you are checked. Only chunks your game has loaded can be scanned, so more than your render distance does nothing.

settings.name: Where
settings.desc: Look everywhere, only underground (hidden bases) or only above the surface.

settings.name: Natural structures
settings.desc: Villages, mineshafts, bastions and so on are named. Hide them from the list, show them in blue, or treat them like any other chunk.

settings.name: Count entities
settings.desc: Item frames, armor stands, paintings and minecarts with chests add to the score.

settings.name: Farm growth evidence
settings.desc: Uses mature/immature crop patterns as a small supporting clue. Crop fields never flag a chunk by themselves.

settings.name: Detect mined geodes
settings.desc: Finds loaded geodes with many exposed budding blocks but very few remaining crystals. This is a separate exploration clue, not a base score.

settings.name: Smallest find size
settings.desc: Ignore finds made of fewer chunks than this. 1 keeps one-chunk huts.

settings.name: Map
settings.desc: A map of the chunks around you. Flagged chunks are numbered, nearest first, and coloured by what was found in them.

settings.name: Corner
settings.desc: Where it sits. Boxes in the same corner stack on top of each other.

settings.name: Map detail
settings.desc: Full: title, coordinates, nearest find and legend. Compact: just the grid and one line. Tiny: only the grid.

settings.name: Map size
settings.desc: How many chunks it shows each way from you.

settings.name: Tile size
settings.desc: The size of one chunk on the map.

settings.name: Show near misses
settings.desc: Chunks that almost made it (20 % or more, but under the cut-off) are tinted amber on the map and listed on the card, so you can see what Zeus is unsure about.

settings.name: Line to the nearest find
settings.desc: A line on the screen that points at the nearest find.

settings.name: Markers in the world
settings.desc: A glowing frame around flagged chunks, visible through walls.

settings.name: Marker range
settings.desc: Flagged chunks closer than this get a frame.

settings.name: Alert
settings.desc: A message when a new find shows up.

settings.name: Watch for activity
settings.desc: Counts the blocks that change far from you (somebody digging, building, filling chests) and points at chunks where it is happening right now, even when no base shows there yet. Your own work and water, lava, leaves and crops are not counted.

settings.name: Activity needs
settings.desc: How many weighted block changes make a chunk count as active. Lower finds more, but also single stray changes.

settings.name: Activity memory
settings.desc: How quickly old block-change evidence fades. Short is responsive; long is better for slow building or mining.

settings.name: Activity counts as evidence
settings.desc: A chunk that already shows signs of a player (beds, storage, player-made blocks) is judged more likely a base while others are changing blocks in it.

settings.name: Pulse active chunks on the map
settings.desc: A pulsing ring on the map around chunks where someone is working.

settings.name: Outline
settings.desc: Top edge: only the top of the find is outlined, so the whole chunk is not boxed in. Top edge + posts adds short corner posts. Full frame is the old curtain.

settings.name: Outline width
settings.desc: Thickness of the outline.

settings.name: Outline colour
settings.desc: Automatic: the colour of what was found. Or pick one.

settings.name: Remember bases
settings.desc: Keeps a list of the bases found on each server (config/zeus-bases.json) so it can tell later whether one was raided.

settings.name: Raid check
settings.desc: Compares a base with what it looked like last time, and looks for fire and scattered items, to tell whether it was raided.

settings.name: Not a base (nearest find)
settings.desc: Tell Zeus the nearest find is not a base. It is never flagged again and Zeus gets a little stricter on this server.

settings.name: This is a base (nearest find)
settings.desc: Tell Zeus the nearest find is a base. It stays flagged and Zeus gets a little more willing on this server.

settings.name: Save finds as waypoints
settings.desc: Adds a waypoint for every flagged find (the nearest ten) that has none yet, named after what it is. They show through walls with the Waypoints module.

settings.name: Copy report
settings.desc: Copies what Zeus sees in the best chunks (counts, structure, confidence) so you can paste it into a message when a base is not found.

settings.name: Forget what I taught it
settings.desc: Removes every answer you gave, on every server.

settings.name: Forget saved bases
settings.desc: Empties the list of remembered bases.

settings.name: Scan again
settings.desc: Forgets everything and scans the area from scratch.

settings.desc: How far around you it looks.

settings.name: Most boxes shown

settings.name: Labels

settings.name: Surface band

settings.name: Lowest height
settings.desc: Ignore finds lower than this height (Y).

settings.desc: Ignore finds higher than this height (Y).

settings.name: Barrels
settings.desc: Barrels.

settings.name: Ender chests

modules.name: Fake Lag
modules.description: Holds the packets you send for a moment and releases them in order, so the server works from an older picture of you. Keeps answers and containers out of it, caps the queue and empties it when you are hit.

settings.name: Mode
settings.desc: Constant: one steady delay. Jitter: the delay wanders a little. Pulse: hold for a while, then release everything at once. Spike: nothing most of the time, then a short burst. Adaptive: the delay follows the server's real answer time.

settings.name: Delay
settings.desc: How long packets wait before they are sent. 150 ms is a bad connection, 400 ms is unplayable for the server but very hard to hit.

settings.name: Jitter
settings.desc: How far the delay wanders around the value above. 0 is a fixed rhythm, which is easier to spot.

settings.name: Hold for
settings.desc: How long each pulse keeps packets back.

settings.name: Then release for
settings.desc: How long everything flows normally between two pulses.

settings.name: Spike length
settings.desc: How long each burst holds packets.

settings.name: Between spikes
settings.desc: How long it behaves normally between two bursts.

settings.name: Follow the server by
settings.desc: Adaptive only: the delay is your measured answer time times this. 1.2 waits a little longer than the server needs.

settings.name: What waits
settings.desc: Movement only is the usual choice and the least disruptive. Actions add clicks and swings. The last one adds chat, containers and everything else, and can confuse an inventory badly.

settings.name: Only while fighting
settings.desc: Holds packets only when you swung or landed a hit in the last two seconds, so walking and building stay normal.

settings.name: Release everything when I am hit
settings.desc: The moment you take damage, everything waiting is sent at once, so you are never fighting from a stale position.

settings.name: Most packets held
settings.desc: A full queue is emptied instead of growing, which is what keeps a server from kicking you for silence.

modules.name: Vanilla Spoof

settings.name: Vanilla client brand
settings.desc: Sends the ordinary game's brand instead of the loader's name. This is the single most obvious hint a server gets.

settings.name: Brand the server sees

modules.name: Friends
modules.description: A list of friends. Choose for each one how you see them: a glow, a bigger name tag, a tag above the head and more.

settings.desc: Furthest distance at which friends are marked.

settings.name: Add the typed name

settings.name: Add the name from my clipboard
settings.desc: Copy a player name anywhere, then press this.

settings.name: Add the player I am looking at

settings.name: Remove this friend
settings.desc: Takes the friend picked above off the list.

settings.name: Glow outline

settings.name: Glow colour

settings.name: Box

settings.name: Bigger name tag

settings.name: Name colour

settings.name: Badge before the name

settings.name: Show health

settings.name: Show distance

settings.name: Hide the game's own name tag

settings.name: Tag colour

settings.name: Tag style

settings.name: Tag place

settings.name: Use this look for every friend

modules.name: Friends Panel
modules.description: A box on the screen with your friends, who is online and who is near you.

settings.name: Corner

settings.name: Only online friends

settings.name: Distance and health

modules.name: Waypoints
modules.description: Save places and see them through walls.

settings.name: Mark where you die
settings.desc: Adds a waypoint at the place you died.

settings.name: Waypoint name

settings.name: Waypoint X

settings.name: Waypoint Y

settings.name: Waypoint Z

settings.name: Hide when closer than
settings.desc: Markers vanish when you are this close.

settings.name: Names and distance
settings.desc: Text under every marker.

settings.name: Remove the nearest

modules.name: Zoom
modules.description: Look closer. Bind a key to hold it with the key on its card.

settings.name: Refill at

modules.name: Durability Alert

settings.name: Warn below

settings.name: Delay

settings.name: Give up after

settings.name: Show singleplayer / multiplayer

settings.desc: Obsidian blocks.

settings.desc: Golden apples.

settings.desc: Ender pearls.
